comparison: Six preserved/candidate agents, one colour-reversed opening pair per opponent pairing: 30 games total, 10 per agent. Fixed before results.
selection: Highest total comparison score; exact ties use the declared preference order. A small local comparison is not proof of strongest possible play.
scope: Combine compatible previously trained value and policy networks with original classical search. The policy retains player imitation, phase sampling and verified puzzle learning. No averaging incompatible tensors, no third-party network, no forced Alien sacrifice.
read_only: Final runtime audit blocks file creation/deletion/rename/directory creation, networking and subprocesses; new entrypoints disable bytecode caching.
